title: Kontext gets a second image engine
summary:
One PR gave `kontext` a BPAIGen-first fallback path, added image guidance control, and changed where two text aliases point.

The existing `kontext` model now tries BPAIGen first and falls back to Kontext if that fails. Its configured maximum side length increased from 640 to 1216 pixels; the `?model=kontext` name and Seed tier requirement stay the same.

Image requests now accept an optional `guidance_scale` parameter and report which service is generating the image. The same PR removed `gptimage` from the image model list and made invalid seeds fall back to 42.

The `openai` alias now maps to `gpt-4.1-nano-roblox`, while `openai-large` maps to `azure-gpt-4.1`. Both previously mapped to `gpt-4o-mini`.

highlights.title: More room for Kontext
highlights.text: `kontext` now tries BPAIGen first, with Kontext as a fallback, and its configured maximum side length has increased to 1216 pixels. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kontext).

highlights.title: Adjust image guidance
highlights.text: Image requests now accept an optional `guidance_scale` parameter. [See the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
